annotations.title: A Guide's timeline, FAQ and glossary

description: Three parts of the Guide: section 'timeline' gives a product's Timeline tab events, oldest first, with their sources, plus the maker's own lifecycle dates; section 'faq' gives the Guide's questions and answers (optional query narrows them); section 'glossary' defines one term, the same text as the Guide's mouse-over.

product_slug.description: A product_slug, e.g. 'apple-watch'. Needed for timeline and faq.

query.description: For faq: words to look for in the questions and answers

term.description: The term to define, e.g. 'field of view'. Needed for glossary.
